name: @felipegenef/opencode-sebas
description: Sebas, the electronic butler for LLM-assisted work: speaks your agents' messages through a local text-to-speech daemon, parks the messages that collide onto a system notification card with a single Listen button, and keeps one voice at a time. Ships the voice MCP, the butler persona and the notification cards as one OpenCode plugin.

scripts.build: bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --target node --format esm --external '@opencode/plugin' && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
